_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Waste Status Report
summary: The Waste Status Report provides the Government with the status of a generator's waste sent for processing or disposal.
use_relationship:
The Waste Status Report provides the Government with the status of generator's waste sent for processing or disposal.
This data item description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the discrete task request as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Site specific identification number
Date of shipment receipt
Incoming manifest number
Approved waste profile number for each container
Incoming container number
Incoming container volume in cubic feet
Daughter container number
Daughter container volume in cubic feet and weight in pounds
Total daughter container activity
Processing completion date
Date of Land Disposal Restriction compliance
Outgoing manifest number
Outgoing shipment destination
Outgoing shipment date
Date shipment was disposed
Volume of waste disposed in cubic feet
Weight of waste disposed in pounds
Activity of waste disposed in curies or millicuries
Anchor weight of the shipment in pounds
Waste process category for the material being processed (e.g., compaction, incineration, metal melting, bulk waste assay, etc.)
Weight in pounds or volume in cubic feet of material processed (e.g., compaction, incineration, metal melting, bulk waste assay, etc.)
Weight in pounds of materials awaiting processing per manifest
Weight in pounds of lead recycled
Date of manifest processing completion
